name: ninepigs
description: Run a household's money in Ninepigs: import bank statements, record what the app could not settle, check and close periods, answer money questions, keep schedules, budgets and funds current.

api_token.title: Ninepigs API token
api_token.description: Create one at ninepigs.com under Settings → Security → API tokens. Use the `record` scope to import and record, `write` to also keep notes, schedules, funds and periods.
